# Babula Shots Drone — Certified Drone Services in the Dominican Republic

> IDAC-compliant drone services with DJI Mavic 3 Pro. Real estate, construction, architecture, tourism, inspection, mapping, and commercial aerial photo/video projects across the Dominican Republic. Part of the Babula Shots RD network.

Owner: Michal Nikodem Babula
Contact: info@babulashotsrd.com · WhatsApp +1 809 720 9547
Rating: 4.9/5 from 98 Google reviews (brand-wide)
Service area: Dominican Republic only
Equipment: DJI Mavic 3 Pro · 4K aerial video
Languages: Spanish and English
Hours: Mon–Sun, 9:00–18:00 Atlantic Standard Time (UTC-4)
